# mysql-ultralight

> A fast-starting, in-memory, MySQL 8 wire- and SQL-compatible server for tests. npm package `@codevachon/mysql-ultralight`. Not for production.

## Docs

- [For AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodeVachon/mysql-ultralight/main/docs/for-agents.md): rules, recipes and error table for wiring it into a test suite
- [Using it in a test suite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodeVachon/mysql-ultralight/main/docs/guide.md): the same material for a person, with the API reference
- [Examples](https://github.com/CodeVachon/mysql-ultralight/tree/main/examples): tested Jest, Vitest and node:test setups against one Prisma app

## Optional

- [What works and what does not](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodeVachon/mysql-ultralight/main/docs/prototype.md)
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodeVachon/mysql-ultralight/main/docs/adr-001-architecture.md)
